text: CHAPEL WALL ALIGNED. Part 2 is part 1 rewritten. Of part 1's 29 word groups: 19 come through with only regular spelling changes, 3 words are swapped for different words every time they occur, and 4 words are dropped completely. The pair counts check out exactly: 74 pairs, minus 8 dropped, plus 4 from longer replacements, gives part 2's 70.
